title: NASA Environmental Data App · RR-3 · ISS habitat environment and radiation

source.publisher: NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR), Environmental Data App
source.radiationAnalysis: NASA JSC Space Radiation Analysis Group (SRAG); doses in water converted from silicon; preliminary analysis; launch-vehicle dose approximated from US Lab averages.

transformations: Five-minute telemetry reduced to hourly medians; habitat summaries start at transfer to the ISS; radiation kept as published daily values.
limitations: Habitat sensors in an ISS rodent research unit and its ground control, not crew cabin air or personal dosimetry. Archived mission context, not current readings.
